name: LPCAnalyzer
description: Live linear-predictive-coding analysis and resynthesis. Models the spectrum of input via an n-sample autocorrelation window and a p-pole LPC filter, then runs source through the derived filter. Best results when source is spectrally flat (impulse train, white noise). Window size n is bounded 1..1024. From sc3-plugins NCAnalysisUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Original signal to analyse with the LPC model

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Excitation signal to filter through the LPC-derived filter

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: Analysis window size in samples (1..1024)

inputs.name: p
inputs.description: Number of poles in the LPC filter

inputs.name: testE
inputs.description: If non-zero, vary the number of poles up to p based on an error condition

inputs.name: delta
inputs.description: Error test threshold (close to but just below 1.0)

inputs.name: windowtype
inputs.description: 0 = rectangular window (abrupt coefficient swap); 1 = triangular window (crossfaded LPCs, smoother but 2x CPU)

name: MedianSeparation
description: Harmonic/percussive source separation via median (or mean) filtering of FFT frames, after FitzGerald (2010) 'Harmonic/Percussive Separation using Median Filtering'. Reads an input FFT chain and writes the harmonic and percussive parts to two output FFT buffers. Outputs 2 trigger-style channels for the two FFT writes. From sc3-plugins NCAnalysisUGens.

inputs.name: fft
inputs.description: Input FFT chain (pre-analysed by an FFT UGen)

inputs.name: fftharmonic
inputs.description: Output FFT buffer index for the harmonic part

inputs.name: fftpercussive
inputs.description: Output FFT buffer index for the percussive part

inputs.name: fftsize
inputs.description: FFT size — must be known at construction time and match all input/output buffers

inputs.name: mediansize
inputs.description: How many FFT frames/bins to median over for harmonic vs percussive comparison

inputs.name: hardorsoft
inputs.description: 0 = hard either/or assignment, 1 = soft proportional assignment

inputs.name: p
inputs.description: Soft-assignment exponent (paper default 2; 1 gives linear proportional)

inputs.name: medianormax
inputs.description: 0 = median (higher quality), 1 = mean (lower CPU)

name: SMS
description: Spectral Modeling Synthesis (Serra 1989) — sines+noise model. Tracks sinusoidal partials in the spectrum and models the residual as filtered white noise. Sines and residual can be transformed independently. Assumes block size 64 and 1024-point FFT internally; optimised for 44.1 kHz. Outputs 2 channels (sines and noise). From sc3-plugins NCAnalysisUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Audio-rate input to analyse

inputs.name: maxpeaks
inputs.description: Absolute maximum number of allowed peaks (initialisation only)

inputs.name: currentpeaks
inputs.description: Current number of allowed peaks (modulatable up to maxpeaks)

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Search tolerance (in spectral bins) for matching peaks across frames

inputs.name: noisefloor
inputs.description: Minimum spectral magnitude for a candidate peak

inputs.name: freqmult
inputs.description: Resynthesis frequency multiplier — multiplies all sinusoidal partials

inputs.name: freqadd
inputs.description: Resynthesis frequency offset — added to all sinusoidal partials

inputs.name: formantpreserve
inputs.description: If non-zero, re-impose the original magnitude envelope when resynthesising (formant preservation) at small CPU cost

inputs.name: useifft
inputs.description: If non-zero, use IFFT-based resynthesis (lower quality but cheaper)

inputs.name: ampmult
inputs.description: Amplitude multiplier — internal compensation for analysis-window power loss

inputs.name: graphicsbufnum
inputs.description: Buffer index for graphics output, or -1 to disable

name: TPV
description: Tracking Phase Vocoder — sinusoidal model after McAulay & Quatieri (1986). Tracks spectral peaks across frames as continuous partials. Resynthesises the tracked partials with optional frequency multiplication. From sc3-plugins NCAnalysisUGens.

inputs.name: chain
inputs.description: FFT chain — pre-analysed by an FFT UGen

inputs.name: windowsize
inputs.description: FFT window size

inputs.name: hopsize
inputs.description: FFT hop size (typically half windowsize)

inputs.name: maxpeaks
inputs.description: Absolute maximum number of allowed peaks (initialisation only)

inputs.name: currentpeaks
inputs.description: Current number of allowed peaks (modulatable up to maxpeaks)

inputs.name: freqmult
inputs.description: Resynthesis frequency multiplier — no envelope compensation

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Search tolerance (in spectral bins) for matching peaks across frames

inputs.name: noisefloor
inputs.description: Minimum spectral magnitude for a candidate peak

name: WalshHadamard
description: Walsh-Hadamard transform — decomposition into square-wave-like basis functions, then reconstruction. Far cheaper than FFT (no trigonometric functions) but the 'sequency' representation is less intuitive. Acts as a 64-point block transform; lowest 'which' basis indices are zeroed for filtering effects. From sc3-plugins NCAnalysisUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Original signal

inputs.name: which
inputs.description: Basis-index threshold — indices below this are zeroed in the reconstruction (0 = pass-through)

name: WaveletDaub
description: Daubechies-4 wavelet transform — decomposition and reconstruction with optional zeroing of low-index coefficients for filtering. Block size n must be divisible by 64 (the standard SuperCollider blocksize). From sc3-plugins NCAnalysisUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Original signal

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: Wavelet transform size — must be divisible by 64

inputs.name: which
inputs.description: Basis-index threshold — indices below this are zeroed (0 = pass-through)
